author: Ariadne I
title: RC-DiagLDS + OrthoReg (k=32) + GradClip
abstract: RC-DiagLDS with stability/structure regularization: MAE plus (i) L2 and (ii) orthogonality penalty on neuron loadings to diversify factors. Also applies gradient clipping. Uses k=32, preserving the residual copy head for strong short-horizon anchors.
